To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified a novel epistatic interaction between rs9486901 and rs2701857 that contributes to the human longevity trait in both males and female.

a case‐only analysis using permutation test identified a novel gene‐by‐ gene interaction between the FOXO3A and FOXO1A genes that highly significantly contributes towards human longevity in the 1905 Danish birth cohort.

a novel permutation method for case‐only epistatic analysis identified a novel interaction between two SNPs in the Forkhead box O (FOXO) gene family which contributes to human longevity in the Danish 1900 birth cohort.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of novel epistatic effects in the FOXO family genes which could contribute to human longevity.
a novel method to detect gene‐gene interaction in case‐only analysis and its application to human longevity.
the development of novel methods for detecting epistasis and their application to human longevity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the FOXO3A rs9486902 and FOXO1A rs2701858 are the most significant SNPs in the Danish 1900 birth cohort for human longevity and that the interaction between the two SNPs is highly significant and contributes to the human longevity trait.
epistasis between FOXO1a rs2701858 and FOXO3a rs9486902 contributes to human longevity.
the present study is the first to identify epistatic effects in the FOXO genes on human longevity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel permutation strategy for case‐only analyses of gene‐by-gene interactions and applied it to the FOXO gene families to identify epistatic effects in human longevity.
the proposed permutation method for the case‐only interaction analysis is a useful tool for detecting epistatic effects of high‐dimensional genetic data.
we have identified a novel epistatic interaction effect on human longevity between two SNPs located in the FOXO genes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the case‐only method can be successfully used to detect epistatic interactions between SNPs in a gene family and the case‐only strategy can be used to detect interactions in a high‐dimensional data.
our permutation strategy is a powerful tool for the case‐only epistasis analysis of high dimensional data and could be applied to other complex traits.

the novel permutation strategy can be used for the case‐only detection of epistasis in high dimensional data, and that the FOXO genes could be involved in the regulation of human longevity through epistatic interaction.
